snippet.title: R-Type Dimensions III Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Humanity’s last line of defense returns. Experience the legendary side-scrolling shooter reborn for a new generation. R-Type Dimensions III elevates the classic formula with stunning 3D visuals, enhanced gameplay, remastered audio, and brand-new features designed for veterans and newcomers alike.
Prepare to fight the Bydo once again.
________________________________________
About the Game

R-Type Dimensions III redefines the iconic shmup experience with:
• Remastered 2D & 3D modes you can switch between seamlessly
• Fully enhanced effects, lighting, and models
• Iconic audio – rebuilt from scratch
• Local co-op support

Master the Force. Survive the swarm. Save humanity.
________________________________________
Release Info
Release Date: May 2026
Platforms: PS5 / Xbox / Nintendo Switch 1+2 / PC (Steam) 
Publisher: ININ Games
________________________________________
